example.title: South Dakota farm silos (center concrete stave silo)

brief: Tall concrete stave silo, about 20 ft across and 70 ft high, its short staves laid in a tight brick-like grid weathered to olive-tan with dark streaks, bound by close-spaced steel hoops; a rusty caged ladder and chute run up one side, a grey steel blower pipe climbs the other to a small domed metal cap. In the example it stands between a newer dark-blue glass-lined storage tank and a white steel tank; here it serves the dairy barn.
